g.text: Data class view · Real membership, capture and compilation
Selected columns. PK = primary key; FK = database foreign key; UQ = unique; [0..1] = nullable.
FK* = (account_id, profile_id) → real_profiles(account_id, id). real_accounts is the account identity table.
current_cycle_id is an application link. UNIQUE(job_id, contribution_id). Archive reads published cycles + film jobs.
